## Four phases. Nothing skipped.

Nothing is bought before the design is approved, and nothing is left undocumented after the install. The same four steps on every job, from a single shop to a factory campus.

1. 01Free

   ### Site survey

   We walk your site, map entry points, blind spots and lighting, and record what each camera must actually see — not guess from a floor plan.

   Free survey report & camera-count estimate

1. 02

   ### System design

   Camera positions, lens choices, storage math for your retention period, network load and power — engineered on paper before anything is purchased.

   Layout drawing, BoM & fixed quote

1. 03

   ### Installation

   Concealed cabling, labelled runs, correct mounting height and angle per the design. We commission, test every channel and hand over documentation.

   Tested system + handover file (logins, layout, warranties)

1. 04

   ### AMC & monitoring

   Scheduled preventive maintenance, lens and storage health checks, firmware updates and priority response when something needs attention.

   Service visits, health reports & remote support

## Sites we know.

A factory floor and a showroom need very different camera plans. We design for the site in front of us.

### Factories & manufacturing

Perimeter to production floor: gate, yard, raw-material bays, machine lines and dispatch. Built for dust, glare and 24×7 shifts.

### Warehouses & logistics

Track every movement from truck bay to rack aisle. Wide-area coverage with fewer, better-placed cameras.

### Offices & IT parks

Lobbies, lifts, server rooms and parking — professional coverage that respects privacy boundaries and looks the part.

### Education & institutions

Campus gates, corridors, buses and boundaries. Coverage that keeps students accounted for without turning the campus into a prison yard.

### Hospitals & healthcare

Entry control, emergency bays, pharmacy and parking — discreet systems that keep records when disputes happen.

### Retail & showrooms

Counter, floor and stockroom coverage with clean faces — enough detail to settle a dispute, discreet enough for customers.

### Homes & apartments

Enterprise-grade reliability, sized for a house or a society: gates, parking, stairwells and entry doors, viewable on your phone.

## Signal over noise.

Surveillance sales run on jargon and fear. We quote from a drawing, with numbers, and hand over a file that proves the work. It is the same discipline our engineers bring to networks, pointed at your perimeter.

[About Shravonix](/about)

- ### Storage sized before purchase

  We calculate recorder capacity from your retention period and camera count, so footage from month eight still exists when you need it.

- ### Network planned, not improvised

  Switch capacity, PoE budgets and cabling routes are part of the drawing. Your cameras never fight your office internet for bandwidth.

- ### Documentation handed over

  Camera map, logins, cable schedule and warranty records in one file. The system is yours; you can service it anywhere.

# Signal over noise.
> Shravonix is an engineering-led CCTV dealership and integrator based in Anand and Nadiad, Gujarat — surveillance designed with the same discipline as the infrastructure it watches.

Shravonix started as an engineering habit, not a shop counter. Our founder spent years keeping servers and networks alive professionally — and kept meeting businesses whose CCTV had been sold to them, not designed for them: wrong lenses, overfull drives, cables nobody could trace, footage that arrived after the incident stopped mattering.

So we turned the discipline around: survey before quote, design before purchase, documentation at handover, and maintenance that treats a fogged lens as the emergency it is. We are based in Anand and Nadiad and work across Gujarat — close enough to be on site fast, and accountable in person.

## What we are

- **A CCTV dealership** — genuine hardware across bullet, dome, PTZ and recording lines.
- **A systems integrator** — the survey, the design drawing, the installation, the handover file.
- **A maintenance partner** — AMC contracts that keep systems proven, patched and watched.
- **Local** — Anand & Nadiad based, Gujarat covered, faces you can hold to the work.

## How we work

### Honest specs

We quote against a drawing, not a mood. If a cheaper camera meets your need, that is the one in the BoM.

### Documented everything

Camera maps, credentials, cable schedules, warranties — handed over, so you own your system outright.

### Footage that answers

Every camera earns its position. If a placement cannot say what it is for, it does not get drilled.

Signal over noise. It is not a slogan we picked for the wall — it is the difference between a system someone sold you and a system someone engineered.

## Privacy is part of the design.

Cameras do not go where they should not. Work areas, rest rooms, neighbour boundaries — a compliant layout is part of the survey drawing, not an afterthought. Your staff see the plan before a single bracket is drilled.

## B2B and B2C, same discipline.

Enterprises get the full four-phase process. Homes and small shops get the same survey-and-design honesty, scaled down — a smaller system, not a lesser one.

# Cookie policy

Last updated: January 1, 2026

## Cookie Policy

This Cookie Policy explains how Shravonix ("we", "us", or "our") uses cookies and similar tracking technologies on our services. Effective Date: 2026-01-01.

---

## What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files placed on your device by websites you visit. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and to provide information to site owners.

Cookies can be "session cookies" (deleted when you close your browser) or "persistent cookies" (remain on your device until they expire or you delete them).

---

## Types of Cookies We Use

- **Essential Cookies** — Required for the basic functioning of our services. These cannot be disabled.
- **Analytics Cookies** — Help us understand how visitors interact with our services so we can improve them.

---

## Other Tracking Technologies

In addition to cookies, we may use the following tracking technologies:

- web beacons
- local storage

---

## Third-Party Cookies

The following third parties may set cookies through our services:

- **Umami** — Website analytics to understand visitor behavior ([Privacy Policy](https://umami.is/privacy-policy))

---

## Your Consent

- We display a cookie consent banner when you first visit our services.
- You can manage your cookie preferences at any time via our preference panel.
- You may withdraw your consent at any time; however, this will not affect the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal.

---

## Managing Cookies

Most web browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings. You can:

- Delete cookies already stored on your device
- Block cookies from being set on your device
- Set your browser to notify you when a cookie is being set

Please note that restricting cookies may impact the functionality of our services. Consult your browser's help documentation for instructions on managing cookies.

# AMC & monitoring
> Annual maintenance contracts for CCTV systems: scheduled preventive visits, per-channel health checks, storage verification, firmware updates and priority response across Anand–Nadiad, Gujarat.

A camera that failed last month records nothing. Our annual maintenance contracts keep your surveillance proven and healthy: scheduled preventive visits, lens and recorder health checks, storage verification, firmware updates and priority response with remote support — so footage exists when you need it.

[Request an AMC quote](/contact#survey)[+91 XXXXX XXXXX](tel:+910000000000)

## What the contract covers

- Scheduled preventive maintenance visits

- Per-channel health checks: lenses, focus, night vision, recording

- Storage and retention verification

- Firmware and security updates

- Priority response with defined visit windows

- Remote diagnostics and support between visits

## Most failures are quiet.

A lens fogs. A drive fills. A cable works loose. The picture still shows on the monitor, right up until you actually need the footage. The AMC makes those failures loud before they cost you.

### We find

Fogged lenses, out-of-focus channels, dead IR arrays and failing drives, before you notice.

### We prevent

Scheduled visits, firmware patches, storage clean-ups and configuration backups.

### We respond

A defined visit window on faults. Remote diagnostics first, van on site when needed.

## Keep the system proven.

Ask for an AMC quote on your existing system. We audit it first, then tell you honestly what is worth maintaining.

[Request the survey](/contact#survey)[WhatsApp](https://wa.me/910000000000)
